name: Maya Autumn Potts
source: Swimming team champion and on again off again girlfriend of one of the school’s most popular boys. Shay actually has dated her current boyfriend, and since then, she’s had it out for Shay. Shay also caught her cheating with the school QB, Josiah, who is also her best friend’s boyfriend, Jane. She verbally harasses Shay and occasionally gets physical. She’s even had her friends help out and  gang up on me. This includes cyber bullying.
